afb.source: Auramine or Ziehl-Neelsen smear batch; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

antigen_lab.source: AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

antigen_rapid.source: Lateral-flow antigen test read at 15 min; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

blood_bank.source: Type and screen with antibody screen; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

blood_culture.source: Lamy B et al., Front Microbiol 2016;7:697 (doi 10.3389/fmicb.2016.00697): most positive cultures flag within 24 h; standard incubation 5 days before a culture is reported negative (Eur J Clin Microbiol Infect Dis 2021, doi 10.1007/s10096-021-04248-9)

blood_gas.source: Hawkins 2007 (PMC2282400): blood gas analysers are near-patient; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

body_fluid.source: Fluid chemistry and cell count; culture final at 48 h; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

cardiac.source: Fourth Universal Definition of MI 2018: troponin result within 60 min of blood draw, doi 10.1093/eurheartj/ehy462

chemistry.source: BMC Emerg Med 2022 retrospective cohort of 23,718 ED visits (doi 10.1186/s12873-022-00763-w): median ED laboratory turnaround 51.1 min (IQR 41.1 to 65.0) for a standard panel

coagulation.source: BMC Emerg Med 2022 retrospective cohort of 23,718 ED visits (doi 10.1186/s12873-022-00763-w): median ED laboratory turnaround 51.1 min (IQR 41.1 to 65.0) for a standard panel

csf.source: Cell count, protein, glucose and Gram stain on a stat CSF; culture final at 48 h (MedlinePlus CSF culture 003769); AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

ct.source: AMIA Annu Symp Proc 2018 (PMC6371246): ED CT order to final report median 4.2 h; CJEM 2015 (doi 10.2310/8000.2013.131235): preliminary report median 2.05 to 2.40 h for CT or ultrasound of the abdomen and pelvis

ct_head.source: Emerg Radiol 2024 (doi 10.1007/s10140-024-02273-7): non-contrast CT head order to final report 1.41 h

cta.source: Emerg Radiol 2024 (doi 10.1007/s10140-024-02273-7): CTA head and neck order to final report 3.86 h; preliminary per CJEM 2015

ecg.source: ESC 2023 ACS guideline: 12-lead ECG acquired and interpreted within 10 min of first medical contact, doi 10.1093/eurheartj/ehad191

echo.source: Formal transthoracic echocardiogram, same day; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

endocrine.source: Same-day immunoassay batch; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

gram.source: AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

haematology.source: BMC Emerg Med 2022 retrospective cohort of 23,718 ED visits (doi 10.1186/s12873-022-00763-w): median ED laboratory turnaround 51.1 min (IQR 41.1 to 65.0) for a standard panel

inflammatory.source: BMC Emerg Med 2022 retrospective cohort of 23,718 ED visits (doi 10.1186/s12873-022-00763-w): median ED laboratory turnaround 51.1 min (IQR 41.1 to 65.0) for a standard panel

micro_culture.source: MedlinePlus Urine culture (003751): results in 24 to 48 hours; preliminary growth report at 24 h

molecular.source: Rapid multiplex NAAT run in the core laboratory; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

mri.source: Emerg Radiol 2024 (doi 10.1007/s10140-024-02273-7): conventional MRI order to final report 6.14 h

poc.source: Hawkins RC. Laboratory turnaround time. Clin Biochem Rev 2007;28:179-194 (PMC2282400): point-of-care testing removes transport and queueing; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

pocus.source: Bedside point-of-care ultrasound read by the treating clinician on completion; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

send_out.source: Reference-laboratory test, reported in 1 to 3 days; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

serology.source: In-house automated immunoassay; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

toxicology.source: AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

urine.source: BMC Emerg Med 2022 retrospective cohort of 23,718 ED visits (doi 10.1186/s12873-022-00763-w): median ED laboratory turnaround 51.1 min (IQR 41.1 to 65.0) for a standard panel

us.source: CJEM 2015 (doi 10.2310/8000.2013.131235): ED ultrasound or CT preliminary report median 2.05 h, final 2.75 h

us_routine.source: Non-urgent outpatient-style study booked for the next list; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies

xr.source: Emerg Radiol 2021 (doi 10.1007/s10140-020-01803-3): median ED radiology department turnaround 70 min before and 36 min after a Lean intervention

xr_portable.source: Bedside portable film, no transport; AcuDx teaching convention (not a measured figure); laboratory practice varies
